periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique downward tilt of approximately 40 degrees toward the midline of the snout.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval/ellipsoidal with a length-to-width ratio of approximately 1.6:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Significant downward taper resulting in a teardrop profile extending toward the zygomatic region.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral separation positioned on the superior-lateral margins of the cranium.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: High smoothness with a uniform semicircular convex curvature.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced brownish-yellow discoloration of the ventral/chest fur in contrast to the bright white cranial fur.
